forbidden_actions: request, read, print, persist, hash, or transmit secret values
remote Git, merge, deploy, release, provider-policy mutation, production-data mutation, or AI action-right activation
invent architecture facts, data rights, authorization, evidence, approval, migration safety, or risk acceptance
combine independent review or audit with source remediation
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Authentication is not authorization: any missing or untrusted subject, resource, action, context, tenancy, ownership, or policy version must fail closed at a server-side enforcement point.
Review, reporting, contract, and audit candidates never imply implementation, live policy change, production mutation, or risk acceptance.

Secret values must never be requested, read, printed, copied, transformed, hashed into evidence, persisted, or sent to a model; verification uses names, references, metadata, policy, and behavior only.
inputs: Actors, resources, operations, trust boundaries, tenancy model, authentication context, and risk policy.
Secret classes, environments, providers, CI/runtime paths, owners, rotation requirements, and authorization.
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Define and verify subject, resource, action, context, tenancy, privileged-path, service-identity, audit, and default-deny authorization contracts.; Define secret classes, owners, environment boundaries, injection, least exposure, logging and redaction, rotation, revocation, retention, and incident procedures without accessing values.
